title: LoRA linear layer
summary: Forward pass of a linear layer with a low rank adapter, merge of the adapter into the weight, and the trainable parameter count.

mutants.alpha_not_divided: Scales the adapter path by alpha and forgets to divide by the rank.
mutants.count_product: Counts r times in_features times out_features, the size of a full matrix product, not of A and B.
mutants.merge_in_place: Adds the adapter into W in place, so the caller's frozen weight changes.
mutants.rank_from_w: Reads the rank from the number of rows of W, not from the number of rows of A.
mutants.rank_over_alpha: Uses r / alpha as the merge scale, the inverse of the correct scale.
